a.lede: Nathan Fielder's documentary about disgraced Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes has created a constellation of colliding personas that interrogate the very nature of authenticity.
a.title: In ‘You Can See Everything,’ Elizabeth Holmes meets her equal in comedian Nathan Fielder

b.lede: Elizabeth Holmes’ husband is a major figure in Nathan Fielder’s new documentary. But who is Billy Evans—and is he really working on a second blood-testing company?
b.title: The Story of Billy Evans and ‘Theranos 2.0’
